**📅 billing/** (billing)
• **daysRemaining** - days until the end of the billing period
• **closePeriod** - button to close the period
• **endReading** - enter the final meter reading here

**💰 costs/** (costs)
• **balance** - current balance (additional payment/credit)
• **totalYearly** - total costs including fees
• **yearly** - consumption costs only

**📈 statistics/** (statistics)
• **lastDay** - yesterday's consumption
• **averageDaily** - average per day
• **averageMonthly** - average per month
